fusions.name: Broadhead
fusions.desc: Looses a blade-headed arrow up to 12 tiles that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Make Room
fusions.desc: Slashes a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: String-Flung Steel
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: At Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 15 seconds.
